text:
emily_fin: FYI invoice 2026-8801 from Omer Tech Ltd (IL) hit AP queue. Vendor requests net payment and asks Redwood to gross-up for any Israeli withholding. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood.com/2026-8801.pdf

invoice-bot: Invoice 2026-8801 flagged: missing TRC and gross-up addendum. Status: REVIEW_REQUIRED :warning:

omer_vendor: hi team, this is Omer Tech Ltd (IL company). line items = license of ML model weights (royalty). our parent co in US receives payments downstream. contract says vendor to be "made whole". happy to provide TRC + bank details.

sasha_tax: clarifier: licensing = royalty territory. Israeli outbound withholding often applies on royalties. need TRC to confirm Israeli residency and check treaty with US. if beneficial owner is US parent, different forms apply (W-8BEN-E).

ravi_legal: contract language vague on gross-up calc. legal won't accept an open-ended gross-up without a signed addendum that defines scope and cap. please upload addendum if vendor expects gross-up.

emily_fin: action items: (1) vendor to upload Israeli TRC and payee bank evidence (2) vendor to sign gross-up addendum with explicit cap or formula (3) tax to confirm statutory rate if no treaty/applies. Payment will be put on hold pending docs.

omer_vendor: uploaded TRC_2026-8801.pdf and Bank_IBAN_****2244.pdf. uploading signed addendum now.

invoice-bot: New files uploaded: TRC_2026-8801.pdf, Bank_IBAN_****2244.pdf by omer_vendor

omer_vendor: Grossup_Addendum_signed_2026-8801.pdf uploaded. we propose gross-up to cover actual withholding up to statutory rate only, with receipts to be provided.

sasha_tax: preliminary: domestic withholding on royalties to nonresidents typically 15% under domestic rules; treaty may reduce rate if beneficial owner claims treaty benefits with proper forms. If beneficial owner is US parent, we need W-8BEN-E from parent plus TRC showing Israeli source. If vendor is Israeli resident receiving payment here, TRC sufficient to apply residency rules.

ravi_legal: reviewed addendum. vendor limited the gross-up to "actual tax paid up to statutory withholding" and will provide tax payment evidence. legal ok with that narrow language. we need finance signoff for budget impact and to confirm GL code for gross-up.

paul_revops: tagging finance-approvals: gross-up up to statutory withholding (approx 15%) possible; please confirm if budget/GL ok.

emily_fin: finance-approvals advised: ok to gross-up up to statutory rate, payment contingent on vendor providing Israeli tax receipt within 30 days. we'll withhold 15% at payment and simultaneously gross-up the net amount in the payment so vendor receives grossed amount; once vendor provides receipt, we will expense gross-up as agreed. if no receipt, vendor to refund excess gross-up.

invoice-bot: Payment status changed: PENDING_REVIEW -> ON_HOLD by emily_fin

omer_vendor: understood and accepted terms. will provide tax receipt once paid to Israeli authority. thanks for clear path.

sasha_tax: tax ops note: keep TRC + addendum + receipt in file for audit. if later determined parent is beneficial owner, we may need W-8BEN-E chains; will advise if that comes up.

emily_fin: summary: payment on hold, once GL approves we'll process with 15% withholding + gross-up per addendum, vendor to submit receipt within 30 days. closing loop unless issues.

invoice-bot: Thread note: "TRC + addendum received; finance approved capped gross-up up to statutory withholding; payment ON_HOLD pending processing."
